senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) urinary canal; כרות ש׳ one whose canal is mutilated.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:2">Yeb. VIII, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01280"><he>כָּרַת</he></cite>. Y. ib. 9ᵇ top. Bab.
ib. 75ᵇ ש׳ כתיב במקום ששופך it says shofkhah (Deut. XXIII, 2) in the place where one pours out (discharges fluid); a. e.
